movements.label: PUFF 1
movements.desc: Hero close-up of the device at 100%, one puff, you exhale, the whole street exhales with you

movements.label: PUFF 40
movements.desc: Walk down the sidewalk: head turns left to the bus driver, right to grandma — everyone is vaping

movements.label: PUFF 9,000
movements.desc: Stop and look up: time-lapse, the vapour rises and forms a pink cloud deck, the sun turns pink

movements.label: PUFF 2 MILLION
movements.desc: Pink rain; street lamps switch on at noon; your open palm catches the drops

movements.label: PUFF 8 BILLION
movements.desc: Visibility collapses, people become silhouettes, coughing; you check the device (48%) and take another puff

movements.label: PUFF 1 TRILLION
movements.desc: Total white-out: you can't see your own hand, only the screen counting down to 1%
Every battery on Earth dies at once: blink, silence, the fog tears open in reverse time-lapse, the sun bursts back

movements.label: PUFF 0
movements.desc: Clean street, people stare at the sky; you lower the dead device… and pull out a new one: 100%

captions.text: One morning, every single person on Earth starts vaping.
8 billion people. Exhaling at the same time.
The bus driver vapes at the wheel.
All that vapour rises… and gets stuck in the sky.
The clouds turn pink. They smell like candy.
Then it rains. Pink, sticky, sweet rain.
Street lights switch on at noon. It's too dark to see.
The fog is so thick, nobody has seen the sun in weeks.
Everyone is coughing… and you still take another puff.
You can't even see your own hand anymore.
Then every battery on Earth dies. All at once.
No more vapour. The fog tears open. The sun is back.
The whole street just stares at the blue sky.
Then you find a new one in your pocket… just one more.
One morning, every single person on Earth starts vaping.

title: What if everyone on Earth vaped?
